---
name: I want to be able to write…
about: A new capability, or a change to the syntax
labels: enhancement
---

**What you want to write in a deck.** Sketch the Markdown, even roughly. The
syntax is the expensive part to get wrong — every deck written against it
becomes a thing that has to keep rendering — so starting from what an author
would type is more useful than starting from how it would work.

```markdown

```

**What it should look like.** A drawing, a screenshot of another tool, a
description — whatever carries it.

**What you do today instead**, and why that is not enough. This is the part that
decides whether it is worth building: a workaround nobody minds is not a
missing feature.
